name: Cultural Difference
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly created all nations from one blood and established their distinct times and boundaries, emphasizing His divine purpose over cultural differences (Acts 17:26). Despite the diversity of peoples and places, salvation and eternal life are found only through faith in Jesus Christ, who is the exclusive way to the Father (John 14:6; John 3:16). The call to be born again transcends cultural distinctions, inviting all individuals into God's peaceful plans and hopeful future (John 3:3; Jeremiah 29:11). Thus, cultural differences exist within God's ordained design but do not alter the universal need for redemption through Christ.
